Create or Update a Change-Set Log

Source: R/rProject-log.R
Log.Rd

Creates .setup/logs/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md, the log for one change set (one Overleaf push), and adds a pending row to .setup/logs/index.md. The log has the commit message skeleton, a "Pushes" table, and the list of files to update in Overleaf.

Usage

Log(
  path,
  topic,
  summary = topic,
  private = file.path(path, ".verify"),
  update = FALSE
)

Arguments

path

Character string. Project path.

topic

Character string. Short topic in kebab case (e.g., "log-spec"). The change-set log uses the same topic.

summary

Character string. First line of the commit message.

private

Character string. Path to a clone of the private repository at the pushed commit. By default .verify in the project.

update

Logical. If TRUE, refresh only the file lists of the newest existing log for topic.

Value

Returns the path of the log invisibly.

Details

The file lists come from comparing the project with a clone of the private repository (by default .verify, kept by .setup/scripts/verify.sh), using the same rules as Verify(). Without a clone, the lists hold TODO.
